system:
Classify rendering-family IDs, compatible treatments and the requested style phrase. rendering_permission already settles authorization without knowing the reference look: its disposition, operation_quote and target are host-owned schema constants. Copy them exactly and NEVER re-author that permission based on a source/target taxonomy mismatch, equal buckets or a loose style mention. No source mismatch grants departure. A deliberate authorized transformation can stay within one coarse family. With no medium-governing visual reference, disposition is no_reference; explicit structured Style remains the requested style phrase.
A theme, atmosphere, physical impossibility or imagined subject matter does not specify a rendering process. Unknown technique/family is empty, rather than guessed animation or painting from unusual content. A requested target can be valid while its rendering family remains unknown. Motion does not by itself change rendering family. requested_style can record an unlicensed descriptive medium mention, while the separate permission still preserves the reference. Do not copy source-medium words into the requested family merely because they conflict.
reference_medium and requested_medium are the supplied semantic taxonomy IDs; unknown is empty. 2d-animation includes flat or digitally drawn illustration, comic/graphic illustration and hand-drawn or cel animation, whether realistic or stylised. painted denotes a work presented as physical painted media, with painterly brushwork/paint surface; it is not a catch-all for every illustrated reference. 3d-animation denotes volumetric computer-rendered animation; stop-motion denotes photographed physical miniature/puppet frame animation. A still illustration may belong to an animation rendering family without making any claim that the attached still itself moves. Use the identified rendering process, not incidental words or whether a drawing is semi-realistic. Reference style comes from the edit-source clip before an incoming replacement/placement portrait, otherwise the first observed image style. Classify that actual observed phrase, never a guessed scene. When the schema includes retained_style, the selected source is a reference sheet: return only its actual rendering medium and stylistic traits, excluding sheet/turnaround/panel/label/contact-sheet/presentation packaging. That cleanup applies ONLY to content references. An actual_frame reference has the opposite obligation: its full original image, including any sheet panels, labels and backdrop, is the actual anchored target frame; never remove those elements or substitute a hero crop. Preserve its original observed style phrase when no rendering change is authorized. If the observed style phrase contains no presentation packaging, copy its existing wording exactly; otherwise remove only that packaging, keeping all actual visual style. No invented restyling. Requested medium records even a loose mentioned medium, while disposition independently decides whether it is authorized. requested_style is only the requested medium noun phrase, excluding treatments; if none, leave it empty. Treatments are the supplied compatible treatment vocabulary, in the order the user asks for them; never classify a medium such as anime as a treatment. Return only JSON. Do not invent explicit instructions or scan from a keyword list.

input.intent: the woman in the technical jacket rides the dragon into an epic battleground, cinematic hollywood scene with dramatic expressions and camera movements
input.observed_phrase: Photorealistic cinematic character concept art and reference sheet, high contrast, gritty, rain-soaked atmosphere

card.summary: Cinematic character reference sheet presenting one tactical-dressed figure in a rainy nighttime hero scene, three full-body studio views, and four detail close-ups.

subjects.descriptor: Adult with East Asian features and a medium build, shown across multiple views of the same character reference sheet.
attributes: adult, East Asian features, medium build
short dark hair with shaved sides and a small tied knot or bun at the back
black stand-collar tactical jacket with chest strap and metal buckle
pose: standing upright with arms relaxed at the sides in the hero, front, and back views
turned in profile in the side view
neutral, serious expression in the portrait close-up

card.environment: Top panel: a rain-slicked urban bridge or walkway at night with metal railings and warm streetlights in the background. Lower panels: a dark charcoal studio backdrop.
card.lighting: Low-key cinematic lighting; cool blue-gray rainy night with warm amber lamp highlights in the hero panel, and soft directional studio lighting in the reference panels.
card.framing: Vertical composite reference sheet: a large environmental full-body shot at the top, three full-body turnaround views in the middle row, and four detail close-ups in the bottom row.
card.style: Photorealistic cinematic character concept art and reference sheet, high contrast, gritty, rain-soaked atmosphere.
card.characterisation: A stoic, combat-ready figure in an all-black tactical outfit, presented as a single character identity across the sheet.

card.summary: A dark fantasy creature reference sheet for a single black-scaled dragon, combining one large atmospheric scene at the top with a front/side/rear turnaround row and four close-up detail panels (head, wing membrane, claw and foot, scale texture).

subjects.descriptor: Large winged dragon with dark iridescent scales and long swept-back horns
attributes: charcoal-black to blue-black armored scales with teal and blue iridescence
several long pale bone-colored horns swept back from the skull
row of tall spikes along neck, spine and tail
large membranous wings with thin veined skin and dark finger struts
four legs with scaled feet and curved pale talons
pose: top panel: standing on all fours, head lowered, wings partly raised
FRONT panel: facing viewer, wings spread symmetrically
SIDE PROFILE panel: standing in profile, tail extended
REAR panel: viewed from behind, wings spread
detail panels: head, wing, foot and scales shown close-up

card.environment: Top panel: dark volcanic terrain with jagged rock formations, wet reflective black ground and distant orange lava glow under heavy dark haze; remaining panels: plain dark gradient studio backdrop.
card.lighting: Moody low-key lighting overall; top panel lit by dim diffuse sky light with warm orange lava glow from the background, turnaround and detail panels lit by soft top-down studio-style light with specular highlights on scales and horns.
card.framing: Single wide landscape sheet divided into panels: a full-width scene at top, a row of three equal full-body views, and a row of four equal close-up crops.
card.style: Dark fantasy photorealistic creature concept art / character design reference sheet
card.characterisation: Menacing, ancient, armored dragon design emphasizing heavy scales, horns and spikes.

rendering_permission.reasoning: The request describes scene action and appends a descriptive style tag (“cinematic hollywood scene with dramatic expressions and camera movements”). It contains no authorizing rendering operation or grammatical instruction to transform or directly render the attached visual reference in a specified target style/medium.
